title: Signed dictator under global negation
statement: Let $n\ge 0$, let $i$ be a coordinate in $\{0,\ldots,n\}$, let $\varepsilon\in\{\text{false},\text{true}\}$ specify whether the dictator is negated, and let $z\in\{-1,1\}^{n+1}$. Negating every coordinate of $z$ negates the value of the signed dictator at coordinate $i$.
hypotheses_covered: the negation flag is a Boolean value
